name: A Hero's critical damage talents do not stack with each other (#7028)
contract: Ice Shards, Burnout and Ruin (Talent.dbc first ranks 11207, 44449, 17959) are SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS on all schools, and each tooltip reads 'Your spell critical strikes now deal 180% damage. This does not stack with other similar effects.'
spell_critical_damage computes Frostbolt 116's critical hit from a fixed 1000 base, so only the crit bonus moves it.
Ice Shards rank 5 (815049) raises that critical hit; Burnout rank 5 (44472) and Ruin rank 5 (59741) on top leave it where Ice Shards put it.
Unfixed, the three bonuses summed and each talent raised it again.
